zh.summary: 追蹤瀏覽器操作如何成為請求、處理與回應，分清一般HTTP／API概念與Streamlit實際採用的框架通訊。
objectives: 說明瀏覽器、HTTP與API在資料交換中的不同角色。
以同一筆合成資料追到驗證、回應、預覽與下載。
區分HTTP狀態、業務結果與尚未觀察的通訊細節。

readingGuide.goal: 說明瀏覽器、HTTP與API在資料交換中的不同角色。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md及reference/原始碼；可先只閱讀。若觀察網路，只用自己的本機合成原型。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一份不虛構端點、能區分傳輸與業務結果的資料流紀錄。

sections.heading: 從按鈕追到真正完成的結果
paragraphs:
這一章最重要的觀念是：你在網頁上按下一個按鈕，並不代表電腦只做了一件事。背後可能發生資料傳送、程式執行、驗證、資料庫存取，以及結果回傳等一連串動作。

學會這章，你就能開始看懂網站背後的運作方式，也能判斷 AI Coding Agent 畫出來的系統架構是否合理。

sections.heading: 一、先從生活例子理解：網路訂餐
paragraphs:
想像你在手機上使用餐廳訂餐網站。

你選好一份牛肉麵，按下「送出訂單」。

畫面上只有一個按鈕，但背後至少存在以下幾個工作：

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一次網頁操作的概念流程
blocks.description: 箭頭表示本例的概念處理順序；實作架構與通訊需另行確認。

items.title: 1. 使用者操作
items.body: 選擇牛肉麵，按下送出

items.title: 2. Browser（瀏覽器）
items.body: 收集品項、數量、桌號等資料

items.title: 3. HTTP／其他通訊機制
items.body: 把資料送往處理訂單的系統

items.title: 4. Server（伺服器）
items.body: 確認商品、價格、庫存與訂購權限

items.title: 5. 資料儲存與業務處理
items.body: 建立訂單、儲存結果

items.title: 6. 回傳結果
items.body: 畫面顯示訂單成立，或提示失敗原因

paragraphs:
這張是典型網站的概念資料流，不是每個網站都完全相同的實作架構。

關鍵在於：使用者看到的介面，只是整個系統的一部分。

sections.heading: 二、Browser、HTTP、API 到底有什麼不同？
paragraphs: 我們用餐廳來比喻。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜網站角色與餐廳類比
rows: 讓使用者操作網站、顯示結果的軟體
用戶端與伺服器交換請求與回應的通訊協定
傳遞點餐單的通訊規則
規定軟體可以要求什麼服務，以及如何交換資料的介面契約
接收請求、執行程式及產生回應

paragraphs:
注意兩個容易混淆的地方。

第一，HTTP 與 API 不一樣。HTTP 是通訊協定，API 是介面契約。一個 API 可以透過 HTTP 提供服務，也可以只是 Python 程式裡供其他程式呼叫的函式。

第二，API 不一定是 REST API。REST 是一種 Web API 架構風格，並非所有 API 都採用 REST。

這也符合 MDN 對 HTTP 的定義：HTTP 主要透過用戶端送出 request（請求），伺服器產生 response（回應）來交換資訊。

sections.heading: 三、HTTP：電腦如何寄出一張「數位訂單」？
paragraphs:
一次 HTTP 通訊，通常可以分成 Request 和 Response。

### 1. Request（請求）

假設我們自己設計了一個訂餐 API。

以下網址與內容均為假想教學範例，並非教材中實際存在的端點。

blocks.heading: HTTP 請求範例
paragraphs: 假想教學訊息，並非本站端點。
blocks.code:
POST /api/orders HTTP/1.1
Host: restaurant.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "item": "beef_noodles",
  "quantity": 2
}

paragraphs:
你可以把這份訊息拆成四個部分：

- Method：`POST`，表示這次請求的操作意圖。
- Path：`/api/orders`，要操作的資源或服務位置。
- Headers：例如 `Content-Type`，告訴對方資料的格式。
- Body：真正送出的資料，例如品項和數量。

這些部分共同構成一個 HTTP 請求。

### 2. Response（回應）

伺服器收到請求後，可能回傳：

blocks.heading: HTTP 回應範例
paragraphs: 假想教學訊息，並非本站端點。

這代表伺服器依照設計好的 API 契約，回報已建立訂單資源。

但「訂單建立」和「餐點已經煮好」仍然是兩件不同的事。

### 常見 HTTP Method

blocks.caption: 表 2｜常見 HTTP Method
rows: 建立或完整取代指定資源

paragraphs: 這些是常見語意，不代表伺服器會自動遵守業務規則。真正允許哪些操作，還是由 API 設計及伺服器實作決定。

sections.heading: 四、為什麼 HTTP 200 不等於任務成功？
paragraphs:
這是本章最值得記住的核心觀念。

假設醫院網站允許病患上傳檢驗報告。

系統收到上傳請求後，回傳：

blocks.heading: 業務驗證失敗的回應
paragraphs: 假想教學訊息，並非本站端點。

HTTP 狀態是 `200 OK`，但內容卻是 `success: false`。

為什麼？

因為這個假想 API 把請求處理成功與業務驗證失敗分開表達。實務上，也可以依 API 契約使用適當的 4xx 狀態碼，例如 `422 Unprocessable Content`。

所以我們應該把成功拆成三個層次：

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜分別核對三層結果
blocks.description: 三列是不同的判讀責任，通過其中一層不保證其餘層成立。

items.title: 第一層：通訊結果
items.body: 請求有沒有成功送達並獲得預期回應？HTTP 狀態是什麼？

items.title: 第二層：業務結果
items.body: 內容是否符合規則？例如資料齊全、庫存足夠、符合受理條件。

items.title: 第三層：使用者任務完成
items.body: 訂單真的成立、報告能正確下載，或使用者確實取得需要的結果了嗎？

paragraphs:
這三層不是彼此保證成立的關係。

### 常見 HTTP 狀態碼

blocks.caption: 表 3｜常見 HTTP 狀態碼
rows: 這次 HTTP 請求成功
服務目前無法處理請求

paragraphs: 來源：[MDN HTTP 回應狀態碼](https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-TW/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status?utm_source=chatgpt.com)。

sections.heading: 五、不是每個按鈕都會呼叫 REST API：認識 Streamlit
paragraphs:
教材特別強調這個觀念。

有些人看到網頁上的「檢查」按鈕，就想當然認為：

「按下這個按鈕，一定會送出 `POST /api/check`。」

這個推論可能完全錯誤。

例如使用 Python 的 Streamlit 製作網頁：

blocks.heading: Streamlit 姓名檢查範例
paragraphs: 僅檢查姓名是否非空；不包含正式身分驗證與授權。

這段程式並沒有自行定義 `/api/check` 這個 REST API。

Streamlit 由框架管理瀏覽器和 Python 伺服器之間的互動。它使用包含 HTTP 與 WebSocket 在內的通訊機制，WebSocket 提供持續的雙向連線，使伺服器可以把更新推送給瀏覽器。




因此，應該這樣理解：

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜自訂 HTTP API 與 Streamlit 的概念對照
blocks.description: 兩條獨立路徑均為概念示意；實際請求、WebSocket 訊息與其他連線，需由文件、原始碼或封包確認。validate() 是程序內呼叫，不是此圖宣稱存在的 HTTP 端點。

items.title: 傳統自訂 HTTP API 的概念
items.body: Browser → HTTP API → Backend → Response

items.title: Streamlit 的概念
items.body: Browser → Streamlit 框架通訊 → Python 程序 → validate()

paragraphs:
兩者均為概念示意。實際使用哪些請求、WebSocket 訊息及其他連線，必須根據框架文件、原始碼或實際封包確認。

你需要分清楚「程式內部的函式呼叫」與「跨網路的 API 呼叫」。

例如 Python 的 `validate()` 可能只是同一個程序中的函式呼叫，根本不需要經過 HTTP。

若要在本機試做，請使用已安裝 Python 與 Streamlit 的環境，將程式保存為 `app.py`，執行 `streamlit run app.py`。先留空姓名並按「檢查」，預期看到「請填寫姓名」；再輸入合成姓名並重試，預期看到「資料完整」。結束後用 Ctrl+C 停止本機伺服器。這些介面結果只證明本範例的姓名檢查，不代表存在 REST 端點或已完成正式授權。

sections.heading: 六、資料在哪裡被檢查，才是系統安全的關鍵
paragraphs:
現在換成銀行的徵信報告系統。

使用者在畫面填寫企業統一編號，前端限制必須輸入八個數字。

但如果系統只在瀏覽器檢查，可能存在漏洞。

因為瀏覽器是使用者可以控制的環境。使用者可能透過其他程式或工具繞過前端限制，直接提交不符合規則的資料。

我們需要考慮多個檢查位置：

blocks.caption: 表 4｜驗證責任的邊界
rows: 提醒使用者格式錯誤，改善操作體驗
重新檢查格式、型別、長度、業務條件和權限
透過適當限制維持資料一致性
再確認目前資料有效，而且使用者有權匯出

paragraphs:
尤其要注意舊資料（stale data）。

假設使用者輸入一筆完整資料，按下檢查後獲得成功訊息。接著他又刪除了必填欄位，但原本的「下載報告」按鈕仍然能使用。

如果後端只相信「之前曾經驗證成功」，就可能把不完整的資料匯出。

正確做法是讓修改後的資料使舊驗證結果失效，必要時在匯出入口再次驗證目前資料。

這個設計原則常稱為 Never Trust the Client（不要直接信任用戶端）。

sections.heading: 七、跨產業應用：相同觀念，不同業務
paragraphs: 同一套資料流與結果驗證方法，可以套用到不同產業的工作。

blocks.caption: 表 5｜跨產業結果驗證
headers: 真正需要驗證的業務結果
rows: 付款、庫存、訂單狀態是否一致
檔案是否有效、患者是否正確、是否有權存取
必填資料是否完整、是否通過權限檢查
伺服器是否保存正確版本，是否在期限內
工單是否建立，設備編號是否有效
工具呼叫是否授權、結果是否真實完成

paragraphs:
AI Agent 也是同樣的道理。

即使工具回傳 `200 OK`，也不能直接推論付款完成、檔案產生成功，或外部操作已達到預期效果。必須檢查工具回應的實際內容，必要時再查詢結果狀態。

sections.heading: 八、實務練習：自己追蹤一次網頁資料流
paragraphs:
如果你使用 Chrome 或 Edge，可以開啟自己控制的本機測試網站，按 `F12` 進入 Developer Tools（開發者工具）。

切換到 `Network` 分頁，然後操作網頁。

範例介面示意；實際瀏覽器畫面可能不同。

僅作說明的模擬紀錄，不是從教材網站擷取的封包。

在 Network 裡，你要學習觀察四件事：

1. Headers：請求送去哪裡？使用什麼 Method？回傳什麼狀態碼？
2. Payload：如果有請求本文，送出了哪些資料？
3. Response：伺服器回傳什麼結果？
4. WS / Messages：如果使用 WebSocket，有哪些實際可觀察的訊息？

最重要的是不要把「我認為應該如此」當成「我實際觀察到了」。

觀察時請使用合成測試資料，不要公開 Cookie、Token、個人資料或其他敏感內容。

模擬紀錄中的 `101` 示意 HTTP/1.1 WebSocket 協定升級，不表示應用任務成功；不同部署或協定版本的握手呈現也可能不同。

sections.heading: 九、整章重點：你真正要建立的思考方式
paragraphs:
可以用以下五個問題檢查任何 Web 系統：

1. 誰發起操作？ 使用者、瀏覽器，還是背景程式？
2. 資料怎麼走？ HTTP、WebSocket、函式呼叫，還是其他方式？
3. 誰負責處理？ 哪個伺服器、程序或元件？
4. 誰負責驗證？ 哪裡重新檢查資料、權限及目前狀態？
5. 如何證明完成？ 只有 HTTP 成功，還是業務結果與最終產物都已核對？

將這五個問題記錄在 `architecture.md`，就是一份最基本的資料流分析。分開標記文件依據、程式核對與實際觀察，未觀察的細節保留待查。

sections.heading: 十、理解檢核
paragraphs:
請先嘗試回答文末理解檢核的三題，再展開參考解析。

本章最重要的一句話：網頁顯示成功、通訊成功、業務完成，是三個需要分別驗證的事情。

exercise.environment: architecture.md及reference/原始碼；可先只閱讀。若觀察網路，只用自己的本機合成原型。
steps: 選缺件與完整兩組合成資料，標記從輸入到程序、結果與下載的資料位置。
核對程式內函式及框架通訊，不填不存在的REST端點；分開HTTP狀態與業務結果。
在architecture.md記下文件依據、程式觀察與未觀察細節；有Network紀錄時只保留不含秘密的必要摘要。
exercise.expected: 一份不虛構端點、能區分傳輸與業務結果的資料流紀錄。
exercise.check: 能指出驗證與匯出在哪裡處理；沒有把HTTP 200或框架重跑當成業務、安全或真人任務完成。
exercise.cleanup: 不公開原始cookie、token或真實資料；未做網路觀察不填封包結果。

en.summary: Trace browser actions through communication, processing and responses, separating general HTTP/API concepts from Streamlit’s actual framework communication.
objectives: Explain the different roles of the browser, HTTP and APIs in data exchange.
Trace one synthetic record through validation, response, preview and download.
Separate HTTP status, business outcomes and unobserved communication details.

readingGuide.goal: Explain the different roles of the browser, HTTP and APIs in data exchange.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and reference/ source; reading alone is sufficient initially. Observe network activity only in your own local synthetic prototype.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and review the checks.
readingGuide.output: A data-flow record that separates transport from business outcomes without inventing endpoints.

sections.heading: Trace a button to the completed outcome
paragraphs:
Clicking one button on a web page can trigger many operations: transferring data, running code, validating inputs, accessing a database and returning a result.

Understanding this chain helps you read how websites work and judge whether a system architecture drawn by an AI Coding Agent is reasonable.

sections.heading: 1. Start with an everyday example: ordering food online
paragraphs:
Imagine using a restaurant website on your phone. You choose beef noodles and press “Submit order”.

Behind that single button are several responsibilities. Follow the information through the six conceptual steps below.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Conceptual flow of a web action
blocks.description: Arrows show the conceptual processing order in this example; verify the actual architecture and communication separately.

items.title: 1. User action
items.body: Choose beef noodles and press submit

items.title: 2. Browser
items.body: Collect item, quantity, table number and other data

items.title: 3. HTTP / other communication
items.body: Send data to the order-processing system

items.title: 4. Server
items.body: Check products, prices, inventory and permission to order

items.title: 5. Storage and business processing
items.body: Create the order and save the result

items.title: 6. Return the result
items.body: Show order acceptance or explain the failure

paragraphs: This is a conceptual data flow for a typical website; actual websites need not implement exactly this architecture. The interface visible to the user is one part of the whole system.

sections.heading: 2. How do browsers, HTTP and APIs differ?
paragraphs: Use the restaurant analogy to separate the responsibilities.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Web roles and restaurant analogies
rows: Software for operating a website and displaying results
A protocol for exchanging requests and responses between client and server
An interface contract specifying services software can request and how to exchange data
Receives requests, executes code and produces responses

paragraphs:
Two distinctions matter. HTTP is a communication protocol; an API is an interface contract. An API can provide a service over HTTP, or it can be a Python function called by another part of a program.

An API need not be a REST API. REST is an architectural style for Web APIs; many APIs use other approaches.

MDN describes HTTP in terms of a client sending a request and a server producing a response to exchange information.

sections.heading: 3. HTTP: how does a computer send a digital order?
paragraphs:
An HTTP exchange generally has a request and a response.

### 1. Request

Suppose we design an ordering API. The following address and content are hypothetical teaching examples, not endpoints implemented by this course.

blocks.heading: HTTP request example
paragraphs: A hypothetical teaching message, not an endpoint on this site.
blocks.code:
POST /api/orders HTTP/1.1
Host: restaurant.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "item": "beef_noodles",
  "quantity": 2
}

paragraphs:
Read the message as four parts:

- Method: `POST` expresses the intended operation.
- Path: `/api/orders` identifies the resource or service location.
- Headers: `Content-Type`, for example, describes the data format.
- Body: the actual submitted data, such as the item and quantity.

Together, these parts form an HTTP request.

### 2. Response

The server could respond as follows:

blocks.heading: HTTP response example
paragraphs: A hypothetical teaching message, not an endpoint on this site.

Under this API contract, the server reports that an order resource was created. Creating an order does not establish that the food has been cooked.

### Common HTTP methods

blocks.caption: Table 2 | Common HTTP methods
rows: Create or completely replace a specified resource

paragraphs: These are common semantics. They do not automatically enforce business rules; the API design and server implementation determine which operations are allowed.

sections.heading: 4. Why does HTTP 200 not establish task completion?
paragraphs: Suppose a hospital website allows patients to upload test reports. After receiving a request, a hypothetical API returns:

blocks.heading: Response with failed business validation
paragraphs: A hypothetical teaching message, not an endpoint on this site.

The HTTP status is `200 OK`, but the body says `success: false`. This contract distinguishes successful request handling from failed business validation. In practice, an API can instead use an appropriate 4xx status, such as `422 Unprocessable Content`, according to its contract.

Check success at three levels:

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Check three outcome levels separately
blocks.description: These rows are separate checks; passing one does not guarantee the others.

items.title: Level 1: Communication result
items.body: Did the request arrive and receive the expected response? What was its HTTP status?

items.title: Level 2: Business result
items.body: Does the content meet the rules: complete data, enough stock and acceptance conditions?

items.title: Level 3: User task completion
items.body: Was the order accepted, can the correct report be downloaded, or did the user obtain the required outcome?

paragraphs:
Passing one level does not guarantee the others. An HTTP response alone cannot prove that the requested business outcome or final user task is complete.

### Common HTTP status codes

blocks.caption: Table 3 | Common HTTP status codes
rows: There is a problem with the request
The requested resource was not found
The service cannot currently handle the request

paragraphs: The status-code reference is MDN HTTP response status codes. These descriptions concern HTTP semantics; determine the business outcome from the API contract and actual response content.

sections.heading: 5. Buttons need not call REST APIs: Streamlit
paragraphs: Seeing a “Check” button does not establish that pressing it sends `POST /api/check`. Consider this Python Streamlit page:

blocks.heading: Streamlit name-check example
paragraphs: This checks only for a nonblank name; it does not implement production authentication or authorization.

The Chinese labels mean “Name”, “Check”, “Data complete” and “Please enter a name”. The code defines no `/api/check` REST endpoint.

Streamlit manages interaction between the browser and the Python server, using mechanisms including HTTP and WebSocket. A WebSocket maintains a two-way connection through which the server can send updates to the browser.

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Custom HTTP API and Streamlit concepts
blocks.description: The independent paths are conceptual. Verify actual requests, WebSocket messages and connections from documentation, source or traffic. validate() is an in-process call, not an HTTP endpoint established by this figure.

items.title: Custom HTTP API concept
items.body: Browser → HTTP API → Backend → Response

items.title: Streamlit concept
items.body: Browser → Streamlit framework communication → Python process → validate()

paragraphs:
Both paths are conceptual. Confirm actual requests, WebSocket messages and other connections using framework documentation, source code or captured traffic.

Separate in-process function calls from network API calls. Python's `validate()` can run inside the same process without an HTTP request.

To try this locally, use an environment with Python and Streamlit already installed, save the code as `app.py` and run `streamlit run app.py`. Leave the name blank and press “Check” to see the missing-name message; enter a synthetic name and check again to see the complete-data message. Stop the local server with Ctrl+C when finished. These UI results do not establish a REST endpoint or production authorization.

sections.heading: 6. Where data is checked determines the security boundary
paragraphs:
Consider a bank credit-report system. The browser requires a company's registration number to contain eight digits. Browser-only validation can still be bypassed: the browser is under the user's control, and another program can submit data that ignores the interface restriction.

Check responsibilities at several boundaries:

blocks.caption: Table 4 | Validation boundaries
rows: Explain formatting errors and improve the interaction
Recheck format, type, length, business conditions and permissions
Confirm that current data is valid and the user may export it

paragraphs:
Pay particular attention to stale data. A user enters a complete record and passes validation, then deletes a required field. If the old download button remains available and the backend trusts the earlier validation result, it may export incomplete data.

Edits must invalidate the earlier result. Revalidate current data at the export entry point when needed, and check access permission there. This follows the principle “Never Trust the Client”: client-side checks help users, while trusted processing must enforce the rules.

sections.heading: 7. The same ideas across industries
paragraphs: The same data-flow and outcome checks apply to work in different industries.

blocks.caption: Table 5 | Verify outcomes across industries
rows: Payment, stock and order state agree
Valid file, correct patient and authorized access
Complete required data and passed permission checks
The server saved the correct version within the deadline
A work order exists and the equipment ID is valid
The call was authorized and its intended result actually completed

paragraphs: The same reasoning applies to AI Agents. A tool returning `200 OK` does not prove payment completion, successful file creation or the intended external effect. Inspect its response content and query the resulting state when necessary.

sections.heading: 8. Practice: trace one web data flow
paragraphs:
In Chrome or Edge, open a local test website that you control. Press `F12` to open Developer Tools, select `Network`, then operate the page.

The example below illustrates an interface; actual browser interfaces can differ. Its entries are simulated, not traffic captured from the teaching website.

blocks.caption: Figure 4 | Developer Tools: simulated Network entries

paragraphs:
Learn to inspect four things in Network:

1. Headers: where did the request go, which method did it use, and which status came back?
2. Payload: if a request body exists, what data was submitted?
3. Response: what result did the server return?
4. WS / Messages: for a WebSocket, which messages can actually be observed?

Keep expected behavior separate from observed behavior. Use synthetic test data and do not publish Cookies, Tokens, personal data or other sensitive content.

The simulated `101` illustrates an HTTP/1.1 WebSocket protocol upgrade. It is not an application-task success status, and not every deployment or protocol version will show the same handshake representation.

sections.heading: 9. A way to reason about any Web system
paragraphs:
Use five questions to examine a system:

1. Who initiates the action: a user, the browser or a background program?
2. How does data move: HTTP, WebSocket, function calls or another mechanism?
3. Who processes it: which server, process or component?
4. Who validates it: where are current data, permissions and state checked again?
5. What proves completion: HTTP success alone, or a checked business result and final artifact?

Record the five answers in `architecture.md` to build a basic data-flow analysis. Label documentation, code inspection and live observations separately; leave unobserved details pending.

sections.heading: 10. Check your understanding
paragraphs: Try the three questions in the understanding-check section before opening their reference explanations. The central lesson is that a success message, successful communication and a completed business outcome each need their own verification.

exercise.environment: architecture.md and reference/ source; reading alone is sufficient initially. Observe network activity only in your own local synthetic prototype.
steps: Choose one incomplete and one complete synthetic record; locate data from input through process, result and download.
Check actual in-process functions and framework communication without inventing REST endpoints; separate HTTP status from business outcomes.
Record document evidence, code observations and unobserved details in architecture.md. Keep only necessary secret-free summaries of any Network observations.
exercise.expected: A data-flow record that separates transport from business outcomes without inventing endpoints.
exercise.check: Locate validation and export processing. Do not treat HTTP 200 or a framework rerun as business, security or human-task acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Publish no raw cookies, tokens or real data. Do not report packet results without observing traffic.

zh.prompt: 某醫院系統回傳 HTTP 200，但內容寫著「檢驗報告資料不足」。能否認定上傳與審核全部完成？
options: 可以，200 就是全部成功
不可以，HTTP 成功與業務結果不同
可以，只要網頁沒有錯誤
無法判斷 HTTP 狀態
rationales: 200 只表達 HTTP 層的成功，不能保證全部任務完成。
業務回應已指出資料不足，還要核對保存與審核狀態。
畫面未報錯仍不足以證明業務完成。
題目已提供 HTTP 200；缺的是業務完成證據。

options: Yes; 200 means everything succeeded
No; HTTP success and the business result differ
Yes, as long as the page shows no error
The HTTP status cannot be determined
rationales: 200 describes HTTP success, not completion of every task.
The business response says data is insufficient; also verify retention and review state.
An error-free page does not establish the business outcome.
The question already gives HTTP 200; business-completion evidence is missing.

options: Yes; all buttons call REST APIs

zh.prompt: 使用者已通過資料驗證，後來又修改資料。匯出報告時應如何處理？
options: 沿用舊驗證結果
只要下載按鈕還在就可以
重新確認目前資料與存取權限
只檢查 HTTP 是否回傳 200

按鈕可見不保證後端能安全匯出。

HTTP 狀態不保證資料完整與授權正確。

en.prompt: Data passed validation and the user then edited it. What should happen when exporting the report?
options: Reuse the old validation result
Allow export if the download button is still there
Recheck current data and access permission
Only check for HTTP 200
rationales: Editing can invalidate the earlier result.
A visible button does not establish safe server-side export.
Check current data and export permission instead of trusting a stale snapshot.
HTTP status does not guarantee complete data or correct authorization.
